effective_source: ISO 32000-2:2020 plus EC3, primary PDF and searchable primary-layout markdown. Footer checked; in this area physical page minus 15 equals ISO printed page.

primary_annotation_audit.effect: Changes Table 99 RBGroups prose: empty outer array explicitly means no radio collections and inner arrays must not be empty. This is a producer constraint; it does not prescribe reader recovery.
Adds a NOTE that Usage/Language does not change the language of any content; it affects selection/visibility only.
Corrects object syntax in examples in §8.11.3.2; example-only.
Revises §8.9.5.4 image Alternate/DefaultForPrinting precedence when OC is present; relevant neighboring context, not a Table 96-101 correction. Its behavior is assigned to the image alternate owner.

cells.condition: Required; OCG name.
Required text string for interactive UI presentation.

Optional name/array, default View. OCG matters to visibility only if its intents intersect the configuration intent; configuration empty Intent means all content visible. Default D Intent shall be View (producer constraint).
Optional usage metadata; used by AS only when a usage application selects its categories.

features.additional_prose: Initial group states come from D; a group is visible only while it and all containing groups allow it.
features.verdict: State, intent and nested hidden-context behavior have assertions. Type/name/default-Intent requirements on malformed input do not alone determine a required reader diagnostic or repair policy.

cells.condition: Required; OCMD name.
Optional one group or array of groups. Null/deleted refs ignored. Missing, empty, or all-null/deleted means P has no effect.
Optional; default AnyOn; valid policies AllOn, AnyOn, AnyOff, AllOff.
Optional since PDF 1.6; if present used instead of OCGs/P. And/Or require one or more operands; Not exactly one.

features.verdict: Current parent records confirm the null and VE-precedence controls pass. The expression depth cap is separately reported as a finite limit; no unbounded-processing claim. Malformed arity remains producer-side unless another reader duty applies.

cells.condition: Required array of indirect refs to every OCG in document, any order.
Required default configuration; used for initial state.
Optional alternate configurations that may be used in particular circumstances; no requirement to provide a configuration selector.

features.verdict: Default D is distinguished from Configs. §8.11.4.2 explicitly directs a processor to ignore optional-content structures if catalog OCProperties is absent. Required writer structure does not imply a mandatory reader refusal algorithm.

cells.condition: Optional configuration presentation metadata; no mandatory alternate selector/UI is stated.
Optional ON/OFF/Unchanged, default ON. If present in default D, must be ON (writer constraint).
Optional arrays applied after BaseState. A producer shall not place a group in both.
Optional name/array, default View; default D shall specify View. All is the special all-intents value on configuration side.
Optional usage-application array; without AS states are not automatically adjusted by Usage.

Optional interactive UI tree. A leading string in a nested array is a nonselectable collection label, not semantic content nesting; unlabelled nested arrays express group hierarchy. Empty array means present no groups; D default empty, other configs inherit D Order; unlisted groups are not presented.
Optional AllPages or VisiblePages. The latter filters Order to groups referenced by one or more currently visible pages. Table provides no printed default; code treats absent/unknown as AllPages.

Optional outer array of one-or-more nonempty group arrays; at most one member ON, turning one ON turns siblings OFF, turning one OFF does not switch another ON. D default empty; alternate configs inherit D value. Empty outer array explicitly means no collections. #225 forbids empty inner arrays.
Optional since PDF 1.6, default empty. Affects user-interface changes only; actions and automatic AS state may change locked groups.

features.verdict: State, action/panel radio behavior, lock propagation, order labels and AllPages presentation have current assertions. The multi-visible-page VisiblePages consumer defect is already recorded globally as 2038-B51; this shard does not duplicate it. #225's invalid empty-inner array does not imply that reader repair is mandatory.

cells.condition: Optional app metadata. If present Creator and Subtype are required; Design-intent groups should include it.
Optional; Lang required and Preferred optional default OFF. Used only when a Language category is selected by AS. #567 says it does not change content language.
Optional ExportState ON/OFF recommendation.
Optional; min and/or max required; defaults 0/infinity; ON for min <= zoom < max.
Optional Subtype descriptive; PrintState optional ON/OFF; if missing, leave state unchanged.
Optional single ViewState ON/OFF; applies on initial interactive viewing when selected.
Optional; Type and Name required if present; Type Ind/Ttl/Org, Name text/string array; exact match ON otherwise OFF when a host identity is supplied.
Optional descriptive pagination marker HF/FG/BG/L; not a Table 101 automatic state category.

features.verdict: Category readers have contrasting state assertions. CreatorInfo/PageElement describe content rather than state rules. Audience-specific behavior is only asserted where host supplies corresponding audience input.

cells.condition: Required View, Print, or Export.
Optional, defaults empty; lists managed groups.

Required array of Table 100 category names. All categories for a group must recommend ON for group to be set ON; multiple same-Event applications are allowed and a group appearing in multiple applications remains ON only if all applicable categories recommend ON.

features.verdict: All events and overlays have public state/pixel tests. Producer required-entry constraints are not converted into reader rejection claims.

reconciliation.2038-B51: Confirmed current defect: VisiblePages consults shown_page only, while a OneColumn arrangement independently exposes two pages. This is already in global findings and expected-failures; not a new defect from this table audit.
reconciliation.T66: Parent execution records the multi-group Language exact/partial selection test passing; older pending draft language is stale.
reconciliation.Null-OCMD control: The current parent wave records null-membership policy-no-effect as passing; older unrun-draft notes are stale.
reconciliation.Locked: Current headless test observes the PDF lock flowing into the query and refused UI command; panel-only unit test is not the sole evidence.

remaining_limits: No claim that invalid required fields, BaseState/Intent restrictions, duplicate ON/OFF groups, invalid VE arity, or #225 empty inner RBGroups require a particular reader recovery.
No claim that the viewer must expose or select optional Configs.
This cell audit does not repeat or certify graphics-placement mechanisms in §8.11.3 or every native UI host.
parent_qualification: Parent checked actual table headers/rows; original reviewer used some cross-reference mentions as locations. Table99 BaseStateOFF-in-default fixtures characterize tolerant malformed-input handling; valid default-configuration and usage controls in optional_content_config_audit supply distinct normative evidence.
